title: Returns policy
text: Acme accepts returns within 30 days of delivery for a full refund. Shipping on defective items is covered by Acme; otherwise shipping is paid by the customer. International returns follow the same 30-day window.

title: Returns policy
text: Return merchandise authorizations (RMAs) are issued within 2 business days. Refunds are credited to the original payment method within 5 to 10 business days of our warehouse receiving the item.

title: Shipping times
text: Standard US shipping takes 3-5 business days. Expedited shipping is 1-2 business days and costs $14.99. Free standard shipping is included on orders over $75.

title: Warranty
text: All Acme electronics include a 12-month manufacturer warranty against defects. The warranty does not cover physical damage or water damage. Submit warranty claims through the support portal.

title: Payment methods
text: We accept Visa, Mastercard, American Express, Discover, Apple Pay and Google Pay. Acme does not accept checks, wire transfers or cryptocurrency.

title: Contact support
text: Support is available Monday through Friday, 9am to 6pm Eastern Time, at support@acme.example or 1-800-555-0100. Weekend emergency support is available for Pro customers.

title: International orders
text: Acme ships to Canada, the UK, EU, Australia and New Zealand. International orders incur duties and taxes at customs; these are the customer's responsibility and are not refundable.

title: Widget specifications
text: The Acme Widget weighs 1.4 kg, measures 20cm x 15cm x 5cm, runs on a 100-240V AC input, and includes a 2-metre USB-C cable.

title: Pricing tiers
text: Free plan: 100 messages per month. Pro plan: $29/month for 10,000 messages. Business plan: $199/month for unlimited messages and priority support.

title: Cancellations
text: You can cancel any subscription from the Billing page. Cancellations stop auto-renewal at the end of the current billing period. We do not pro-rate partial-month refunds.
